precisionNote: Money uses decimal(18,2); percent uses decimal(5,2); ratios (SPI/CPI/TCPI) keep full decimal precision in intermediates per source line 4, rounding once at display. 'FullPrecision' fields below were computed with .NET System.Decimal arithmetic directly from the raw inputs (28-29 significant digits) so a later xUnit test can assert to whatever decimal places it needs; 'Rounded2dp' fields are the money-precision values stated verbatim in the source markdown. Do not treat the very last 1-2 digits of a FullPrecision value as load-bearing - chained decimal division can differ in the last significant digit depending on operation order without changing the correctly-rounded 2dp result.
